title: Niagara Falls Guided Vehicle Tour Canada: Boat, Skylon & Journey
blurb:
Experience the best of Niagara Falls on the Canadian side with our fully guided vehicle tour led by knowledgeable tour guides.

Visit top attractions including the Boat Ride, Skylon Tower, Journey Behind the Falls. Enjoy a complimentary maple syrup tasting experience at the Maple Leaf Place.

Unlike crowded bus tours or rushed group walks, this small group tour offers comfort and personalized insights.

Pass by the famous Clifton Hill, Queen Victoria Park, Oakes Garden, Brock Hotel, Bird Kingdom, Rainbow Bridge, Whirlpool Bridge, the Buddhist Temple, Nikola Tesla Monument, White Water Walk & Class VI Rapids.

Get amazing photo opportunities at the Spanish Aero Car.

Hotel pickup and drop off included!

*Boat ride will be replaced by the Flying Theatre Attraction in winter and spring seasons.*
